patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient describes a continuous 'nagging' headache for the past month, initially thought to be related to a cold. Over-the-counter ibuprofen provided only mild and temporary relief. Recently, has experienced dizziness and nausea, notably improving when outside in cold air. The patient has been staying in a cabin for 5 weeks and reports no significant travel.

Secondary_Symptoms: Temporary relief upon exposure to cold air

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Hypertension, type II diabetes mellitus, and asthma.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Denies tobacco or illicit drug use.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Currently asymptomatic in the office; no fever, cough, chest pain, or recent changes in vision or hearing.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and manage a patient presenting with headache and dizziness.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’ve had a continuous nagging headache for about a month that didn’t really go away after a cold, and ibuprofen only helped a little and briefly. Lately I’ve also felt dizzy and nauseous, but it seems to improve when I get outside in the cold air.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any scratched, rubbed-raw skin, or any small open spots on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone says you stop, or you wake up gasping)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t been told that I stop breathing or have pauses in my breathing during sleep, and I haven’t woken up gasping.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: Doctor, I haven’t had any minor injury or trouble using an injured area, and I don’t have severe pain, swelling, bruising, or deformity.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist—or any noticeable difference compared to the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the skin of your chest), especially after an injury or from coughing/strain?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall—no dark or discolored areas, and nothing after injury, coughing, or straining.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed urinating much more than usual—no increased frequency or larger amounts of urine recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances that could affect your health—such as alcohol, tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs—either recently or in the past?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t smoke or use illicit drugs, and I haven’t used opioids or stimulants. I do not drink alcohol in any significant way either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no— I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine and I’ve been making it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spots, sores, or growths anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t had any nosebleeds or blood coming from my nose recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—no rash on my chest, back, or belly.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or thighs?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in my legs or around my calves or thighs.”
